svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Lodge conceptual section and envelope build-up
svg.desc: Transverse section of Common lodge looking east, 3.00 m from the west end, with a wall build-up detail. From inside to outside: interior lining on service battens 40 mm, steel container shell (corrugation depth) 43 mm, continuous external insulation (type tbd) 150 mm, ventilated cavity / weather control (tbd) 25 mm, replaceable timber rainscreen 22 mm; 280 mm in total. Clear interior height 2.65 m; floor 0.64 m above grade on piles. Not a specified building assembly.

g.text: Section A–A, cut 3.00 m from the west end, looking east • envelope concept • not a specified assembly
Drawn at about 18× the section scale; interior on the left
Interior lining on service battens: 40 mm
Roof: 38 mm steel roof, 200 mm tapered external roof insulation (nominal), 20 mm cover
Floor: 20 mm finish, 160 mm container floor, 150 mm insulation below the container
floor, 12 mm vented, rodent-resistant soffit board
Air, vapour, thermal bridge and fastening details are intentionally unspecified. The
roof steps between hall and modules need snow-drift, flashing and drainage design.
Diagram only. Assembly, fire, moisture and code compliance must be designed. Selective spray foam requires separate assessment.
